test_title: PYST 31: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 1 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '4'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26449ca5c9ac1a931b66deed1f98c4053b44e43b58400f743438e6c4f9cdf8cd.png]
solution:
Here we are given two dices and faces 1 and 3 are common in both.

So, we have:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0507b0e01c6344b1650b126ac3a032207f867935850c1dee239d6d35f7332126.png] 

 

So, we will rotate the 2nd dice in such a way, that it will have the same positions of the common faces.

Thus, the face opposite to 4 will be 2.

Hence, the face opposite to number 4 will be number __**2**__ .
